questions.q: Our left midfielder has room. Where can he join as a third attacker?
options: Behind the strikers, in the middle
Up beside the front pair, on the left
questions.explain: Right. Beside the front pair he makes three attackers against Blue's three defenders.
choiceExplanations: That is the central midfielder's space. Two players there leaves the left side empty.

questions.q: Put the attack and the recovery in order, from first to last.
options: Left midfielder joins the front pair
questions.explain: Yes. He joins, the ball goes to the striker, Blue steals it, then he runs back to rebuild the three.
choiceExplanations: Yes. He joins, the ball goes to the striker, Blue steals it, then he runs back to rebuild the three.
He can only pass to the striker after he has joined the front pair.
Blue intercepts after the pass to the striker, when the return goes astray.
He recovers last, once Blue has won the ball.

questions.q: This time our right midfielder joined the attack. Blue wins the ball. Where does he go?
questions.explain: Yes. He rebuilds the midfield three, so two midfielders don't have to do every job.
choiceExplanations: Staying high leaves only two midfielders to stop Blue's attack.
The back three are already there. The gap is in midfield, next to the central midfielder.
